These activities have helped foster employee pride, boost morale, and promote a culture of volunteerism within the organization. This commitment highlights the C ompany’s dedication to advancing Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles, particularly focusing on the Social (S) and Governance (G) dimensions. Volunteerism & Organizational Culture
“Chaosua –Wholesome presented the company’s products and Chaosua  drinking water to Wat Chaeng Hai Temple and the Nakhon Ratchasima Provincial 
Industry Office to be delivered to evacuees from the border areas of Sisaket  and Ubon Ratchathani provinces, following unrest along the border. The initiative
